g.text: Units: months. Treatment difference: ICI+CT minus CT.
a: within-group treatment-difference Wald test. b: B minus NB treatment-difference Wald test. All P values nominal.
JUPITER uses OOF groups; ESCORT uses frozen external groups. Greenwood plug-in variances; predictions treated as fixed.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a33122
